basis.governing_question: How can Vale Verde Water Company lose less treated water through leaks in its network, starting with two pilot districts?

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish how much treated water the network loses and where, as the baseline for the loss-reduction program.

gate.label: Diagnostic sign-off
gate.decision: Does the steering group accept the loss baseline as the basis for the program design?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define the loss-reduction program and the new leak-detection routine, and plan the pilot in two districts.

gate.label: Go/no-go on pilot
gate.decision: Does the steering group approve the program design and the pilot in two districts?

phases.name: Pilot
phases.objective_one_line: Run the new leak-detection routine in two districts and measure water losses against their pre-pilot level.

gate.label: Go/no-go on rollout
gate.decision: Do the pilot results in two districts justify rolling the program out to the others?

phases.name: Implementation
phases.objective_one_line: Roll out the leak-detection routine to the remaining districts so every district runs it by the end.

gate.label: Rollout completion
gate.decision: Is the new routine running in every district, so measurement can start?

phases.name: Measurement
phases.objective_one_line: Track water losses and routine adoption against the two success criteria, and report the results.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Does the steering group accept the measured results as the final result?

architect_notes: The brief's 'rollout' stage is named Implementation as the closest fit; confirm whether the firm executes the rollout or the client does.
Departs from performance_improvement: adds Design, Pilot and Measurement phases because the brief names five stages.
